units.meaning: As a condition to occupy an approved child restraint system (notwithstanding any other requirement of this chapter, and furnished by the operator or a parent, guardian, or designated attendant), the child must be accompanied by a parent, guardian, or an attendant designated by the child's parent or guardian to attend to the safety of the child during the flight.

source_spans.quote: (A) The child is accompanied by a parent, guardian, or attendant designated by the child's parent or guardian to attend to the safety of the child during the flight;
